name: Rubber Plant
hook: Leaves suddenly dropping? Check for cold drafts.

steps.title: Bright, indirect light
steps.tip: Morning sun from an east window is ideal; avoid harsh afternoon sun. It tolerates lower light too.

steps.title: Let the top dry slightly
steps.tip: Water thoroughly, then let the top of the soil dry a little. Yellow leaves mean the soil stays too wet.

steps.title: Warm, with no drafts
steps.tip: Best at 24–27°C by day and 16–18°C at night. Cold drafts and sudden drops make leaves fall.

steps.title: Feed in spring and summer
steps.tip: Use liquid houseplant fertilizer every 2–4 weeks while it grows, less in low light, and none in winter.

steps.title: Wipe the big leaves
steps.tip: Dust blocks light. Wipe leaves with water and check for mealybugs, scale and spider mites as you go.

steps.title: Repot every 2–3 years
steps.tip: Repot in late winter or early spring. In the years between, replace the top layer of soil with fresh mix.

outro: Bright light, careful watering and no drafts keep those leaves on.
